The stated mappings direct a reviewer to unrelated requirements while claiming a 5.0 L1 pass.
findings.proposed_fix: Replace the chapter-number/name pairs with the ASVS 5.0 mappings and cite the versioned standard when reporting requirement IDs. Retain the current failed-or-unclear reporting behavior.

findings.cited_line: - **Step 6: Reference repos.** Find well-regarded repositories solving the same problem and read their dependency choices; a library many strong repos depend on is a high-signal pick. WHERE `repomix` is present, read a reference repo's dependency manifest without cloning via `npx repomix@latest --remote <owner/repo> --include "package.json,requirements.txt,Cargo.toml,go.mod,pom.xml"` and capture the result into `REFERENCES.md`; WHILE `repomix` is absent, fall back to a WebFetch of the raw manifest URL. Presence-gated, no install (ADR-0027); on a failure (rate limit, private repo) record `[not fetched: reason]` and never guess.
findings.defect: The presence-gated no-install instruction invokes npx repomix@latest. An existing older installation does not satisfy that requested version, and [npm exec documentation](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/npm-exec/) permits installing missing requested packages into its cache. The same line promises without cloning, whereas [Repomix CLI documentation](https://repomix.com/guide/command-line-options) defines --remote as cloning and packing a repository. Both operational claims contradict the named invocation.
findings.proposed_fix: Invoke the already-resolved installed repomix executable directly, with the existing --remote and --include flags, and describe its temporary remote clone accurately. If avoiding any clone is required, use the raw-manifest WebFetch path instead.
